ES&H Professional

Usa, Texas, Houston

Experience: Not applicable

Conventional Energy

Introduction

What are you going to do

Job Summary

In this position, you will incorporate safety and health requirements into complex project planning, design activities, and operational processes to minimize potential risks and impacts. You will conduct risk assessments, contribute to bid reviews, lead meetings and communications, and monitor performance trends. Your recommendations will help improve the effectiveness of safety procedures and work practices.

Major Responsibilities

  • Supports the implementation of the safety portion of the ESH Program, including both technical and administrative elements.
  • Assists in the development and execution of Safety and Health Management Plans, supporting procedures, and training programs.
  • Provides guidance to Engineering, Construction, Procurement, Subcontracts, Commissioning, and other departments to ensure safety and health requirements are incorporated into project planning and execution.
  • Interprets safety and health standards and delivers support in plan development, risk assessments, and ESH program implementation.
  • Investigates moderately complex safety issues and regulatory requirements and prepares related reports and documentation.
  • Assists with safety studies, risk evaluations, program assessments, and audit activities.
  • Participates in emergency response efforts, incident investigations, and corrective action processes.
  • Communicates and collaborates with stakeholders to address and resolve concerns.
  • Takes part in meetings with clients, project teams, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.
  • Performs ESH inspections and monitoring activities to identify hazards, assess risks, evaluate corrective measures and controls, and verify compliance with contractual, regulatory, project, and company requirements.

Essential skills and knowledge 

Education and Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) in Occupational Safety, Occupational Health, or a related field, with 5-8 years of relevant experience; or alternatively, 9-12 years of relevant work experience.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Specialized expertise in a safety discipline (such as Personal Protective Equipment, Lockout/Tagout, Fall Protection, Excavation Safety, or People-Based Safety) or an engineering discipline (such as Civil, Process Safety, or Mechanical Engineering), or other fields.
  • Knowledge of safety management systems, monitoring programs, principles, and methodologies.
  • Understanding of safety and health regulations, applicable legislation, and permitting processes managed by regulatory agencies.
  • Knowledge of engineering, construction, and subcontractor work practices and processes.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with proficiency in computer applications.
  • Bachelor of Science degree in a specialized technical discipline (e.g., Safety, Industrial Engineering, Public Health) or Process/Mechanical Engineering, and/or practical experience performing the responsibilities outlined above.
  • Bilingual proficiency in both Spanish and English is required.

Our Culture and Values

At Brunel, we are proud of our unique corporate culture, which is shaped and nurtured by the collective efforts of our employees. Our work environment is characterised by an authentic, communicative and inclusive approach to teamwork that fosters an atmosphere of collaboration and creativity. Our values are at the center of everything we do – for our clients, our colleagues and ourselves.

Learn more about our global network of specialists!

Our ESG Commitment

Since 1975, our mission has always been to connect specialists to exciting career opportunities, to support the development of these careers, and to offer fair and equal employment. This has enabled us to create a truly sustainable and durable business model. Having a passion for people and caring deeply for the environment is not only part of Brunel’s DNA but is also reflected in our culture and values. As a global company, we take our social responsibility very seriously.
